28 configured RTX 3060 SMs divided by two SMs per GA10x TPC = 14 logical TPCs; no GPC distribution is inferred.

One PolyMorph Engine per calculated logical TPC; 14 TPCs gives 14 engines.
The GA10x SM is partitioned into four processing blocks.
28 configured RTX 3060 SMs × four GA10x processing partitions per SM = 112 logical partitions.
Each partition has one 16-FP32 datapath and a second 16-lane FP32/INT32 datapath; together these provide 32 FP32 lanes when executing FP32.
The second datapath in each GA10x partition has 16 lanes that can execute either FP32 or INT32 operations.
One third-generation Tensor Core is present in each GA10x processing partition.
